gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-noto-sans-k: Raw, tactical, stocky: Capture Smallz fills the line with big-bodied lowercase. Noto Sans Kayah Li keeps its brush ends lifted before each curve closes, with capitals only slightly taller than the lowercase.
Noto Sans Kharoshthi keeps its curves from closing back on themselves, laying a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line. Below Capture Smallz, a full page would read friendly and current.
Blunt, tactical: Capture Smallz stamps big lowercase while Noto Sans Khojki leaves wide exits and a large eye on every e. Stocky letters above, see-through ones below: that tension is the draw.
Noto Sans Khudawadi reads clean and friendly, capitals barely taller than lowercase, rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook. Capture Smallz adds a raw, stocky foil; that split is the draw.
Noto Sans KR keeps its curve gaps generous and its ascenders stubby. Capture Smallz is best at shouting with big-bodied lowercase, while Noto Sans KR is best at quietly carrying a big x-height.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-noto-sans-l: Noto Sans Lao reads modern and crisp, its x-height pushed well above the usual and its mouths left open. Under Capture Smallz, paragraph after paragraph would move briskly and stay legible.
Noto Sans Lao Looped makes words read as solid blocks rather than skylines, with bowls left unfinished on one side. Against raw Capture Smallz, that tidy block texture is the lasting impression.

Noto Sans Lepcha reads approachable, its curves keeping a wide opening. Its lowercase has the stature of cast iron capitals, and next to the big-bodied lowercase of Capture Smallz, that shared heft is the link.

Big-bodied lowercase is the whole personality of Capture Smallz, raw and tactical. And Noto Sans Limbu, with gaping curves and tall-bodied small letters, would keep paragraphs feeling approachable and contemporary.

Capture Smallz does loud best, stamping raw, tactical, big-bodied lowercase into every line. While Noto Sans Lisu does steady best, with wide-open s curves and ascender tops sitting a hair below the x-height line.
